articles.title: Thousands without power in Toronto's east end, parts of downtown, utility says
articles.summary: Thousands of customers are without power in Toronto's east end and parts of downtown, according to Toronto Hydro. The TTC says the outage is affecting elevators and escalators at various Line 2 subway stations.

articles.title: CEBL reverts to 1-game final after cancellation of Winnipeg-Brampton series opener
articles.summary: The Canadian Elite Basketball League is returning to a one-game championship on Saturday in Winnipeg after the opening game of a best-of-three series between the Sea Bears and hometown Brampton Honey Badgers was cancelled Wednesday night "due to condensation on the court" at Brampton's CAA Centre.

articles.title: Oakville enacts data centre pause as Ontario municipalities wrestle with AI buildout
articles.summary: Oakville enacted a one-year moratorium on new data centres, becoming the first Ontario municipality to take the step as local lawmakers grapple with the concerns surrounding the new wave of facilities powering artificial intelligence. articles.title: Brampton landlord to face jail time after fire that killed pregnant woman, child in 2023
articles.summary: An Ontario landlord has been sentenced to jail time after being convicted of seven charges following a Brampton fire that left a pregnant woman and her daughter dead more than three years ago.

articles.title: Former Raptors coach fights Ontario over nearly $700K tax paid on multimillion-dollar home
articles.summary: Former Toronto Raptors head coach Nick Nurse and his wife are embroiled in a legal dispute with the Ontario government over its refusal to reimburse the couple nearly $700,000 in foreign buyer tax they paid on their Mississauga home.

articles.title: New Peel Regional Police helicopter entering into service
articles.summary: The new Peel Regional Police helicopter is part of an Ontario government-backed joint air support unit in the Greater Toronto Area.

articles.title: Anti-immigration speaker banned from U.K. still planning to attend Ontario conference
articles.summary: OTTAWA — An Austrian man who has been permanently banned from the United Kingdom for promoting extremist narratives said this week he hopes Canada won't deny him entry ahead of a conference he's set to speak at in Hamilton this month.

articles.title: Bradford vows Bloor Street W. bike lanes are 'coming out' if he's mayor
articles.summary: Toronto mayoral candidate Brad Bradford is promising the removal of bike lanes on a west-end street should he win the city’s top job.
